name: The Reef at Atlantis
positioning: The Reef, a residential-style suite tower within Atlantis on Paradise Island, with ocean-view suites that each have a kitchenette or full kitchen, access to Paradise Beach and full access to the Atlantis resort
best_for: Families who want a spacious suite with a kitchen, ocean views and the Aquaventure water park at hand
Travelers who want an apartment-style stay on the quieter grounds shared only with The Cove

facts.text: The Reef offers spacious, family-friendly suites with ocean views.
Accommodations at The Reef range from studio suites to one- and two-bedroom suites.
The Reef offers residential-style amenities for a home-away-from-home experience.
Conde Nast Traveler describes The Reef as a hotel-within-a-hotel at Atlantis.
Marble floors, sleek sofas and chandeliers fill The Reef's public spaces.
The Reef has its own in-transit lounge on the first floor near the elevators.
As Atlantis guests, Reef guests have full access to the Aquaventure water park features at no additional cost.
The Atlantis marine habitats span 14 lagoons with more than 50,000 aquatic animals.
At Dolphin Cay, Atlantis guests can swim alongside dolphins and spend time with sea lions.
Fish by José Andrés, a seafood-focused restaurant, is just steps from The Reef.
Mandara Spa at Atlantis blends Balinese healing, European therapies and natural elements unique to The Bahamas.
Atlantis is on Paradise Island, across the harbor from Nassau.

highlights.text: Conde Nast Traveler says a stay at The Reef is like living in your own apartment with a kitchen, living space and ocean views.
Every room at The Reef has a kitchenette or a full kitchen.
Paradise Beach offers a tranquil stretch of white sand and turquoise water for guests of The Reef.
Cascades Pool is reserved for guests staying at The Reef or The Cove.
The Reef and The Cove hotel grounds are exclusive to guests of those two hotels or those with dinner reservations on that side of the resort.

considerations.text: Meals are not included with the room reservation.
Atlantis Paradise Island is a cash-free resort.
To check in at The Reef, at least one guest must be 18 or older.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The Reef at Atlantis, Paradise Island
